entries.title: Game code, procedural artwork and sound
entries.creator: Man vs. Clankers project, developed with Codex
entries.use: Gameplay, UI layout, weapon diagrams, favicon, armored survivor, temporary robot loading fallback, orbiting drones, architectural geometry, safety paint, projectile shapes and rigid-part animations were created for this game. Sound effects are synthesized with Web Audio oscillators; there are no imported music or sound samples.

entries.title: Browser-provided fallbacks
entries.creator: The player’s browser and operating system
entries.use: Arial, sans-serif and monospace are fallback font names only. No files for these system fonts are redistributed.
